gloss: to learn one's lesson; to be taught a lesson

definitions.gloss: to learn one's lesson; to have had enough
definitions.explanation: To have such a bad experience that one decides not to repeat the same mistake or behavior.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{懲|こ}りて⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧になった。
examples.english: I became cautious after learning my lesson from failure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{懲|こ}りない。
examples.english: He never learns his lesson no matter how many times he fails.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二日酔|ふつかよ}い→二日酔い：08331_futsukayoi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{懲|こ}りて、⟦{飲|の}み{過|す}ぎない→飲み過ぎる：22592_nomisugiru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: After learning my lesson from hangovers, I try not to drink too much.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive verb)

Ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし}/{上一段|かみいちだん})
- {懲|こ}りない (negative)
- {懲|こ}りて (te-form)
- {懲|こ}りた (past)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{懲|こ}りる - to learn one's lesson from ~
- {懲|こ}りず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - without learning one's lesson
- {懲|こ}り{懲|ご}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to have absolutely had enough (emphatic)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {懲|こ}りない⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ - someone who never learns
- {懲|こ}り{懲|ご}りだ - I've had more than enough

USAGE:
Often used in the negative form {懲|こ}りない to describe someone who keeps making the same mistakes. The phrase {懲|こ}り{懲|ご}り is an emphatic form expressing complete exasperation.
